tinycore.description: Minimal Tiny Core Linux box used by the vagrant-libvirt acceptance tests. Archived from the HCP Vagrant box infernix/tinycore before the registry shut down.

tinycore-two-disks.description: Tiny Core Linux box with a second blank 10G disk, used by the two disks acceptance test. Built from vagrant-libvirt/tinycore by scripts/build-two-disks-box.sh; it was never published to a registry.

debian10.description: Debian 10 box with qemu-guest-agent, used by the qemu agent and package domain acceptance tests. Archived from the HCP Vagrant box generic/debian10 before the registry shut down.
